lifecycle_consistency.name: lifecycle_consistency
lifecycle_consistency.value: ("complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."status" = 'open' AND "complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."return_note" IS NULL AND "complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."received_at" IS NULL AND "complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."received_by" IS NULL) OR ("complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."status" = 'received' AND "complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."return_note" IS NOT NULL AND "complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "complaints_private"."complaint_information_requests"."received_by" IS NOT NULL)
